brief.headline: Close the 13.6% gap to Sayaji's ₹66.48/KG price — you're paying ₹14.26 L/yr extra for the same material

priceAsk.summary: Match Sayaji Industries' ₹66.48/KG for Dextrose Anhydrous IP
priceAsk.basis: That's the best price we already pay another supplier for identical material. The open market asking price is ₹60–81/kg (typical ₹66–73/kg), so ₹66.48 sits right in the fair zone. Their ₹75.51 is 13.6% above our benchmark.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep 30 Days After Receipt — no change needed

brief.financialLeverage: They sell ₹514.62 Cr a year and keep about ₹3.70 of every ₹100 they sell (3.7% net margin), so they're making money but not flush. They're growing fast — 21.4% a year — which means they want new orders. We're tiny to them: our ₹59.65 L is just 0.12% of their sales, so on our own we have almost no pull. Bundle more volume or play them against Sayaji and Gulshan to get traction.

evidence.point: We pay ₹75.51/KG; Sayaji charges us ₹66.48/KG for the same thing
This 13.6% gap costs us ₹14.26 L every year
Open-market asking prices for Anhydrous Dextrose IP run ₹60–81/kg, typically ₹66–73/kg — our ask is market-fair
They're growing sales by 21.4% a year — they need volume
We're only 0.12% of their ₹514.62 Cr revenue, so we need to bundle or threaten a switch to matter

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch & polyol maker with ₹2359.06 Cr revenue, health score B (62/100) — a proven drop-in alternate to our current suppliers

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist (₹821.13 Cr revenue, health C 57/100) growing capacity in starch and dextrose

alternates.name: Tirupati Starch & Chemicals Ltd
alternates.why: Indore wet-miller making Dextrose ANHYDROUS (IV-fluid grade) — exact form match; confirm IP monograph CoA before switch (health D 27/100, ₹365.39 Cr)

risks: We're a tiny 0.12% customer — they can walk away unless we bundle more SKUs or threaten a real switch to Sayaji or Gulshan
If we push too hard on price alone they may see no profit and cut us loose — tie the ask to volume growth (their 21.4% growth shows they want orders)
Sayaji is already our best-price supplier at ₹66.48/KG — make sure that relationship stays strong in case Universal says no
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We want to keep buying from you, but right now we're paying ₹75.51 when our best supplier charges ₹66.48 for the same Dextrose — let's talk about closing that 13.6% gap.
